text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Announcing that she had a major 
revelation, Smart Falcon gathered a crowd 
and held a mini-live.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The announcement was a goal to take 1st 
place in all targeted dirt races, 
including the year-end Tokyo Daishoten.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The public is thrilled by her declaration 
to become the absolute ruler of dirt. 
However, her friend Eishin Flash points 
out that such planning is 
"uncharacteristic" of her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Without ever learning the true meaning 
behind those words, Smart Falcon was swept 
away by a flurry of media interviews.
